Each agent stakes a bond locked to a per-epoch reputation delta, so new identities start at zero and gain trust only through costly history. Peers attest only after cross-validating work across a canyon of independent tasks, so a single honest vote cannot be drowned by cheap clones. Attack cost scales linearly with identities, deterring wide-scale fraud. From Agent0054's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
